zh.title: 丹佛機場人員遭Frontier Airlines引擎吸入 揭三年6起安全疏漏
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines引擎吸入事件揭丹佛機場三年六起安全疏漏
body: 丹佛機場發生一起人員遭 Frontier Airlines 客機引擎吸入事故。據報導，這起事件代表該機場在過去三年時間內，累計已發生第六起飛行場安全疏漏事件，引發各界對管制區安全管制的關注。
這一連串安全入侵事故暴露了丹佛機場周界防禦機制的缺失。在發生此起人員吸入引擎事件後，相關主管機關已著手對該機場的入侵偵測能量與現場緊急應變流程進行全面審查。
主管機關將透過審查全面檢視現有周界防護層級，旨在釐清當前安全防禦漏洞，並研擬改善措施以提升飛行場整體的安全防護與監控能力。

en.title: Denver Airport Sees 6th Security Breach in 3 Years After Man Ingested by Frontier Engine
en.summary: Man ingested by Frontier Airlines engine in Denver's sixth airfield security breach in three years.
body: A man was ingested by a Frontier Airlines engine, representing the sixth airfield security breach at Denver's airport in three years. The incident has raised fresh concerns regarding perimeter security at the facility.

The string of six separate security breaches has highlighted perimeter defense gaps at the Denver airport. In response to these recurring incidents, authorities are actively evaluating existing detection technologies and airfield access controls.

Authorities are reviewing detection and response protocols to strengthen airfield security measures. The ongoing review aims to identify security vulnerabilities and enhance operational safeguards across airport perimeter areas.
